headline: Bekaert Shares Jump 8% on Strong Third-Quarter Sales Growth
summary: Bekaert shares jumped 8% after the company reported strong sales growth for the third quarter.
why: Bekaert is a global technological leader in steel wire transformation and coating technologies, with quarterly sales indicating underlying industrial demand.

impacts.name: Bekaert SA
impacts.why: Strong reported sales growth directly improved investor sentiment and equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Better-than-expected sales expansion during the third quarter surprised investors and drove heavy buying in the stock.
